persistedQueryReceipts.scope: The anonymous AVSpec search interface explicitly searches published observations. Only rows returned by that interface and anonymously downloadable from the matching official record identifier are eligible. Only exact target-name and bounded date results from the documented photometry endpoint are eligible.

Only public ADS bibliographic metadata is retained. CTAS does not download, mirror, or assert reuse rights for article full text; publisher and repository links retain their own access and reuse terms. Event association requires an exact retained transient name.

ASAS-SN describes Sky Patrol light curves as public and provides publication citations. CTAS may link an operator to the official HTTPS coordinate-query page. No automated provider-data request was sent. The official legacy HTTPS query form requires reCAPTCHA and says users needing more than 100 light curves should contact ASAS-SN. The published V2 client and documentation currently use an unencrypted HTTP API, while the linked HTTPS V2 host and client repository are unavailable. rules.position: Two positions with no stated uncertainty are inconsistent when they are more than 2 arcsec apart; when one states an error radius, the separation is compared with 3 times that radius.
rules.redshift: Two redshifts with no stated uncertainty are inconsistent when they differ by more than 0.005 (about 1,500 km/s); transient and host redshifts are different definitions and are listed, not compared; host redshifts of differently named hosts are an identity ambiguity.
rules.revision: A retracted row, or a superseded row of the same provider whose value differs beyond the property's rule, is a revision or retraction; a revision within the rule is consistent; the earlier value stays visible.
rules.sigma: Two values that both state an uncertainty are inconsistent when they differ by more than 3 combined standard deviations (uncertainties added in quadrature; a stated position error radius is treated as one standard deviation).
